name: Offline app shell is registered
description: Verifies production startup registers the service worker for offline use.
steps: Wait for the page to load
Inspect browser application storage for the active service worker
expected: The service worker registers and caches the app shell for later offline visits.

name: Routines persist locally
description: Verifies routines remain on the device after a reload.
expected: The routine remains available from local storage.

name: Offline navigation fallback
description: Verifies the cached app shell can be used when navigation cannot reach the network.
steps: Load the app online at least once
Go offline in browser developer tools
expected: The cached app shell opens without a network connection.
